name: Dheja Daruna Panjalu
title: QA Engineer
tagline: I build the automation that lets teams ship fast without breaking things.
summary: QA engineer with 4+ years at Shopee (Sea Labs), Astra Life and KitaLulus. I build automated test frameworks for microservices and high-traffic features, wire them into CI/CD, and work daily with teams in Singapore and Shenzhen. My stack is Python, Playwright, Selenium and Robot Framework, plus AI-assisted testing where it saves time.

bullets: I own quality for the PDP and Rating features: test suites, bug triage and prioritisation, and the full defect lifecycle.
I run backend automation regression for the Cart/PDP/Rating team. That cut manual work in the weekly production release cycle.
I push the team toward internal QA tools and AI-assisted testing for generating, running and analysing tests.
I work with engineers and product across Singapore and Shenzhen to keep quality standards consistent.
I introduced automation testing to the team from scratch and owned the automation effort end to end.
I built and maintained the CI pipeline on GitLab, and wrote test scripts in Python (Selenium) and Robot Framework.
I worked with Business Analysts to turn requirements into automated test coverage.
I expanded automation coverage and mentored other QA engineers on writing their own scripts.
I ran scrum for the QA Automation Squad: sprint planning and execution.
I reviewed code for the automation codebase.
